llm.summary: The skill's stated purpose (domain registration via unhuman.domains) matches the instructions, but it directs the agent to execute remote npm packages (npx) and to perform fully autonomous bitcoin payments via an agent-wallet daemon and store management tokens locally — behaviors that are coherent with the purpose but present real risk and deserve caution.

dimensions.detail: Name/description align with the runtime instructions: the SKILL.md tells the agent how to search, register, manage DNS, and renew domains on unhuman.domains and how to pay via an agent-wallet. The use of an agent-wallet daemon and local token storage is consistent with a domain-registration workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent to run npx unhuman and npx @moneydevkit/agent-wallet to perform actions and to store management tokens at ~/.unhuman/tokens.json. They also allow fully autonomous registration/renewal with the --wallet flag (automatic payment). These are within the skill's purpose but grant the agent the ability to execute remote code and to make financial transactions without human confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, but the instructions rely on npx which fetches and executes packages from the npm registry at runtime. That means arbitrary remote code will be pulled and run when the agent follows the skill — package versions are not pinned and no provenance or signature checks are described.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials, which is plausible. However it implicitly requires a running agent-wallet daemon and will create/modify ~/.unhuman/tokens.json (management tokens). Those stored tokens and the agent-wallet's funds are sensitive resources; the SKILL.md does not describe any safeguards, least privilege, or how tokens are protected.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false (good), but autonomous agent invocation combined with the explicit option to auto-pay (--wallet) increases blast radius: an agent that can invoke this skill and that has access to a funded agent-wallet could spend funds and register domains without human approval. The skill does not require explicit human confirmation for payments when --wallet is used.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing or enabling this skill: 1) Treat npx as remote code execution—verify the unhuman and @moneydevkit/agent-wallet packages on npm (owner, version, recent publishes, source repo) and prefer pinned versions or signed releases. 2) Do not allow autonomous payments unless you fully trust the packages and the agent: run without --wallet or require manual confirmation for payments. 3) Limit or inspect the agent-wallet daemon (ensure it has no or minimal funds and appropriate authentication). 4) Be aware the skill will write management tokens to ~/.unhuman/tokens.json—review and protect that file and consider storing tokens in a secure secrets store instead. 5) If possible, test in an isolated environment or sandbox before granting the agent wallet access or enabling autonomous invocation.
